# PhotoSwipe 5.4.4

The image lightbox of the Stack theme, served from the site itself instead of `cdn.jsdelivr.net` (#4).
`data/external.toml` points Stack's `[PhotoSwipe]` keys here. MIT license, see `LICENSE`.

The files are copied unchanged from the npm package `photoswipe` 5.4.4,
